exposure: clinical characteristics (e.g., specific diagnoses like allergic rhinitis and asthma, symptoms)
cohort: The study included children found to be sensitive to cats at an allergy clinic over one year, along with two control groups.
finding: Cat ownership was significantly associated with cat sensitivity, although most patients with cat sensitivity were not cat owners, and elevated total IgE levels (>1000 IU/mL) were also significantly higher in cat-sensitive patients.
cross-section timing: over a period of one year
